system.description:
Green, cunning, and perpetually vilified, Goblins thrive on the edge of chaos. For a Goblin, vanishing into the shadows is not just a skill—it's an identity. After all, what kind of Goblin would you be if you couldn't slip away unnoticed?

Skedaddle

Can move 2 spaces for free after you become the target of an attack or negative effect (after damage, ignoring difficult terrain).

You know Goblin if your INT is not negative. [M]

Goblinoid Tribes: Urban Spawn — The people, the stench, the smog, and the sprawl. Home.

Rooftop Reflexes

+1 Perception. [A]

Half damage from falling or forced movement. [M]

Nim+ Volume I ancestry variant (LewisH, Santuric). Variants replace the base ancestry: pick this instead of the standard version. Note: variants make your hero stronger than normal.
